description: Add a task to one account's list. Needs a title; notes and a due date are optional. parent makes it a subtask of another task in the same list; previous places it after that sibling (first otherwise).

account.description: Which account this writes to: a label from list_accounts. Required; writes have no default.

due.description: The day it is due: YYYY-MM-DD. Google Tasks keeps a date only, never a time of day.

parent.description: A taskId in the same list: the new task becomes its subtask.

previous.description: A sibling's taskId: the new task goes right after it.

task_list.description: The list's taskListId from list_task_lists or list_tasks; "@default" (the default) is the account's default list.

name: create_task
title: Create task
